description: Rules the specification itself declares non-testable. Every entry must name a FeatureId whose `Conformance` cell is NOT_COVERED, explain why no executable case can exist, cite the normative text, and state the condition under which the exemption must be re-examined. `python tools/features_coverage.py --strict` fails if an entry is malformed, unknown, stale or hides an uncited rule.

exemptions.reason: La ligne declare elle-meme « pass : aucun (oracle absent) » et sa colonne Conformance vaut NOT_COVERED. La machine abstraite du noyau pur n'a aucune forme executable : MACH-1.4 fixe son etat a NOT_IMPLEMENTED et interdit de citer un resultat machine comme preuve. Inventer un cas reviendrait a inventer un oracle, ce qui est precisement le faux PASS que T2 doit interdire.
exemptions.review_condition: Revoquer cette exemption des qu'une machine abstraite executable existe (MACH-1.4 quitte NOT_IMPLEMENTED) ou si la ligne F-META-006 obtient une forme executable ; la couverture stricte doit alors repasser a 188/188 sans exemption.
exemptions.approved_by: Definition du gate T2 (docs/roadmap/CORE-1.0-GATE-MATRIX.md, 187/187 regles testables)
